audit.whatIsWrong: The full layer marks Jayce ahead at First item and 2+ items (phases[5].side / phases[6].side = 'Jayce'), which directly contradicts the content layer's own late/spikes text ('the lane inverts', 'out-duel your zero-defense frame') and the packet level chart, which both give the later stages to Aatrox.
audit.why: Aatrox's first drain item plus World Ender (R) increased healing beats accelerated Shock Blast chip; Jayce buys no defensive stats. Both directions of the matchup must agree on who owns each stage.
audit.corrected: Flip phases[5] and phases[6] to Aatrox with ratings 4/10 and 3/10 and stage-specific reasons.

audit.whatIsWrong: Spike text is present in the content layer but the full layer's breakdown.spikes and phase reasons are generic template ('Eclipse is your spike — force fights the moment it completes') with no Aatrox-specific timing and no cooldown numbers.
audit.why: Jayce's real spike is level 3 (Acceleration Gate) and his real cliff is Aatrox's level 6 plus first drain item. Naming the levels makes the advice actionable.
audit.corrected: Rewrote breakdown.spikes and the level-6/first-item phase reasons around World Ender (120/100/80s) and Aatrox's first drain item.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interaction is absent everywhere: Infernal Chains (W) grounds its target, so it denies To the Skies! (Hammer Q) as an escape while you are being dragged. The page only says the chain 'locks you'.
audit.why: _missing-interactions.json flags dash-denied for this pair, and the Aatrox kit carries the grounding flag on W with Riot's own drag description. This is the single mechanic that turns a lost trade into a death.
audit.corrected: Stated the grounding explicitly in the Key Ability Interactions report entry, in dosFull, and in breakdown.cooldowns with W's 20/18/16/14/12s cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns lists no actual cooldown numbers and the packet flags zero sequencing cues for this matchup.
audit.why: Umbral Dash (E) at 9s rank 1 and Infernal Chains (W) at 20s rank 1 are the two windows that decide whether a step-up is safe.
audit.corrected: Replaced with the real numbers and the sequencing they imply.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[2] and dontsFull[1] have titles that do not match their descriptions — 'E-knockback his approach' is described as 'Aatrox wastes The Darkin Blade', and 'Get caught in melee form' is described as 'Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.'
audit.why: Mismatched title/description pairs read as broken copy and give no usable instruction.
audit.corrected: Rewrote both descriptions to match their titles with real mechanics.

audit.why: The packet flagged "World Ender's" in spikes[3] and "Darkin Blade" in wants.foe[0] as suspect ability names. "World Ender's" is the correct name in possessive form — false positive, left alone. "Darkin Blade" is missing Riot's leading article; corrected to 'The Darkin Blade'.
audit.corrected: wants.foe[0] now uses the exact Riot name.

edits.after: Land the full The Darkin Blade chain into the Q3 sweetspot knockup, then Infernal Chains (W) — its grounding denies your Hammer Q escape

notes: MC_WR_TABLES.jayce lists aatrox at 48.3 while the packet reports 51.6 Emerald+ over 2438 games. I did not touch the WR table (forbidden), but the two sources disagree and the full-layer 'EVEN / 4-10' framing was written against the lower number. Worth reconciling upstream. Also: the content 'win' array, the full 'phases' sides, and the packet levelChart disagree three ways for this matchup (content gives Jayce levels 1-4 then Skill at 6; packet gives Skill at level 3 and level 6). I aligned the full layer to the packet for the two late stages only, where the contradiction with the page's own prose was flat. IMPORTANT: phases[5].side and phases[6].side are still "Jayce" and should read "Aatrox" — I dropped those edits because a 5-char to 6-char change is outside the applier's +/-10% length band and would be rejected. The ratings are corrected to 4/10 and 3/10; the side fields need a hand fix or a mirror-fix pass.
